name: Danganronpa Minus
source: Video game version of Danganronpa Minus by DefaultName, originally a Korean novel/fanfiction inspired by both the original Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc and fangame Danganronpa Another ~Another Despair Academy~.
translation: 《弹丸论破Minus by DefaultName》的电子游戏版本，最初是一部韩国小说/同人小说，灵感源自原版《弹丸论破：触发快乐浩劫》和同人游戏《弹丸论破Another ~Another Despair Academy~》。
